source: To request advice, a specified service or transfer of care from a healthcare provider or organisation about the subject of care.

Not to be used to represent the document recorded as part of a single clinical encounter or visit. Use COMPOSITION.encounter for this purpose.\n\nNot to be used to provide a transfer of care summary to another organisation or provider - use COMPOSITION.transfer_summary for this purpose.
Document sent from one treating healthcare provider or organisation to another, for the purpose of requesting advice, a service or transfer of care.
Additional information required to capture local context or to align with other reference models/formalisms.
For example: Local hospital departmental information or additional metadata to align with FHIR or CIMI equivalents.
